# AnalyzeG — Full Platform Documentation

## What is AnalyzeG?
AnalyzeG is a verified video review intelligence platform based in India. It connects brands with authentic consumer insights through verified video reviews. Reviewers record short videos of products they use, get paid through a dual-stage payout model, and brands receive analyzed data including sentiment analysis, demographic breakdowns, and Power BI dashboards.

Founded in 2025, AnalyzeG is a registered MSME (Udyam) based in West Bengal, India.

## How AnalyzeG Works for Reviewers
1. Sign up and complete profile verification on AnalyzeG
2. Choose from available review opportunities matching your interests
3. Record an authentic 2-5 minute video review of the product
4. Submit for verification — our multi-factor system validates identity and authenticity
5. Get paid in two stages: up to Rs 40 after verification, then remaining payout from your 50% share when the review is sold

Payment options include UPI and bank transfer. No social media following is required — earnings are based on review quality and authenticity.

## How AnalyzeG Works for Brands
1. Register your brand on AnalyzeG
2. Select your review package (500, 1000, or 1500 reviews)
3. Specify target demographics: state, age, gender
4. Receive 30-second in-hand product video reviews within 2 minutes to 24 hours
5. Access your Power BI dashboard with advanced analytics
6. Download raw data files (CSV/Excel) with video links for independent analysis
7. Use purchased videos as advertising content (video licensing included)

## AnalyzeG Pricing for Brands
- Professional: 500 reviews at Rs 5,00,000 (Rs 1,000/review)
- Enterprise: 1,000 reviews at Rs 9,00,000 (10% savings)
- Market Leader: 1,500 reviews at Rs 12,75,000 (15% savings)
- All packages include: Power BI dashboard, raw data export, video licensing, advanced analytics, demographic filtering

## AnalyzeG Analytics Features
- Sentiment analysis from video content and survey responses
- Keyword trend detection across review datasets
- Competitive benchmarking — compare your brand against industry rivals
- Demographic segmentation by state, age, and gender
- Exportable reports for team sharing
- Custom Power BI dashboard templates

## AnalyzeG Technology
- Multi-factor verification system ensures every review is authentic
- Advanced analytics extracts insights from video and structured data
- Enterprise-grade security protects all review data and brand information
- Platform processes reviews with delivery from 2 minutes to 24 hours

## AnalyzeG FAQ
Q: How much can reviewers earn?
A: Limited-time model: up to Rs 40 after verification, plus remaining payout from 50% share when review is sold.

Q: What equipment do reviewers need?
A: A smartphone with a decent camera and stable internet connection. AnalyzeG provides guidelines for optimal video quality.

Q: How does verification work?
A: Multi-factor verification validates identity and review authenticity through multiple security checks.

Q: How quickly do brands receive reviews?
A: Most review requests are fulfilled within 2 minutes to 24 hours. Brands receive notifications as reviews are submitted and verified.

Q: How is brand data protected?
A: All data is encrypted with bank-grade security. Access controls and audit logs ensure complete data privacy and compliance.

## AnalyzeG Values
- Integrity: Every review is verified for authenticity
- Innovation: Advanced analytics transforms raw video into actionable insights
- Fairness: Dual-stage payout model rewards reviewers fairly and transparently
- Transparency: Clear rules, visible analytics, and open communication
